title: Analysis code and figure source data for "Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation"
description: Analysis scripts and source data for the five bioinformatics Methods sections of Contact-dependent intercellular dTMP transfer sustains tumor cell proliferation: human A549 bulk RNA-seq, GSE148071 single-cell TYMS/TK1/MKI67 analysis, Visium TYMS/TK1 neighborhood analysis, cell2location spatial deconvolution and NMF, and Kras/Trp53 amplicon analysis. Each analysis folder records inputs, provenance and execution limits. Rendered figures and presentations are excluded; numeric source tables and plotting code are retained. MIT applies to laboratory-authored code; third-party code and scientific data retain their original terms.
